simple.summary: אֶלְפַּעַל (ʼElpaʻal) means Elpaal , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 8 11.

definitions.full: H508. Elpaal אֶלְמַּ֫עַל proper name, masculine ( God of doing ? compare Phoenician פעלאבסת ); a Benjamite 1Chr 8:11-12 , 18 . אֶלְצָפָן see אֱלִיצָפָן .
